evidence: Reading a middle column: row 0 is dark brown back outline; rows 1-3 are the lighter gold top surface; row 4 is a bright cream/orange front-edge highlight line; rows 5-6 are a dark brown eave shadow; rows 7-31 are the red and gold vertical front face with reels and coin slots.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, the slot machine is drawn with blocky, unshaded flat fills: the red front panel is a single uniform red, the gold top and base are flat single-colour rectangles, and the reels are solid blocks of red, yellow, and white with no shading steps or surface grain.
